sections.title: Autoriõigusega kaitstavad teosed
sections.body: Protected works: literary, artistic, scientific works. Requires originality – 'result of author's own intellectual creation' – and expression in objective form.

sections.title: Autori isiklikud õigused
sections.body: Moral rights (inalienable): attribution, naming choice, integrity, right to withdraw.

sections.title: Autori varalised õigused
sections.body: Economic rights (transferable): reproduction, distribution, translation, adaptation, public performance, exhibition, transmission, making available on-demand.

sections.title: Õiglase tasu õigus
sections.body: Non-waivable right to fair remuneration for audiovisual and rental rights.

sections.title: Personaalseks kasutamiseks
sections.body: Personal use exception – private reproduction/translation permitted (excludes architecture, software, databases, limited-edition art, sheet music).

sections.title: Teaduslik ja hariduslik kasutamine
sections.body: Educational/scientific exceptions: quotation with attribution, illustrative use in teaching, non-commercial reproduction, news reporting, parody/satire.

sections.title: Teksti ja andmete kaevandamine
sections.body: Text and data mining: permitted for research institutions and for commercial entities (with opt-out mechanism for rights holders).

sections.title: Puuetega inimestele
sections.body: Disability accommodation: accessible format copying for visually/reading-impaired persons. Limiting contracts void.

sections.title: Orbteosed
sections.body: Orphan works – after diligent search, public institutions may use works with unknown rights holders.

sections.title: Teenistusülesannetes loodud teos
sections.body: Works created in employment vest in employer (economic rights).

sections.title: Kaitse tähtaeg
sections.body: Duration: life of author + 70 years. Collective/employment works: 70 years from publication. Moral rights permanent.

sections.title: Kohtualluvus
sections.body: Copyright disputes: exclusive jurisdiction of Harju Maakohus.
